CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is stated.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/layout statement, and an explicit origin/status are all present for p0/current/n2 at current time.

A.rationale: No text links an attention/allocation condition or change to the identified content's organization/presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries identify items (red/blue) and their coordinates.

D.rationale: Origins/kind fields explicitly attribute status/source separate from the identified content coordinates.

O.rationale: The report states layout rules and shows grouped candidate/current nodes and origin metadata describing presentation/access.
